narrative.overview: Neutral black and gray surfaces, off-white type and primary lime actions pair a cinematic career promise with a familiar conversational workspace. Preserve the accepted centered hero, decorative WebGL trajectory and original north-east trajectory mark. The compact floating navigation dock and fuller product journey extend that world. Self-hosted Geist remains the brand face; Arial resumes and Georgia letters are intentional document typography.
keyCharacteristics: Geist interface with Arial resumes and Georgia letters
Neutral border-separated conversation and contextual inspector
Dark neutral companion and light neutral closing band
Compact 660px phone with a notification-focused first state, seven sample states, visible-only four-stage autoplay and manual/pause controls
Licensed semantic activity table with local filters and details
Six scroll-linked chapters: discovery, requirements, resume, supporting material, review/apply and updates
First-party brand marks and documented illustrative stock photos
Explicit sample provenance and execution boundaries
Three desktop OS selector cards with source ZIP/build instructions and explicit unpublished installer/mobile release states
Labeled semantic status badges: green ready/completed, amber review/unknown, red exclusion; no colored panels
Black main workspace, #070707 sidebar and #080808 inspector; simulated demo sourcing and truthful unconnected personal mode
Direct Product link, live outlined GitHub-count pill with unavailable em dash and 700px mobile hiding
Four simulated company watchers: PostHog, Stripe, Linear and Cloudflare; first-party marks; console first in DOM order, desktop left in a 1.15fr 1fr grid and before explanatory copy on mobile
Authored video-preparation employer/project brief, four-part outline, selected script passage, clipboard feedback and checklist; retired Pexels 8463168 portrait retains historical provenance only
Six chapter controls meet 44px minimum targets; refreshed actual shared-workspace harness capture
Persistent six-scene scroll camera with paper and approval close-ups, manual frame controls and static reduced-motion fallback
Actual Geist footer glyphs revealed by pen masks with bounded settling bounce
Native Expo black/neutral materials, lime actions and visible real-data/error states; fixture verification only

rules.name: The Continuous Frame Rule
rules.body: SourceStory keeps six persistent scene layers and one product camera. Scroll directly scrubs camera keyframes, scene transform/opacity and document emphasis; reversing scroll rewinds the same stage. It has no timer or timed grid transition. The explanatory rail deliberately fades and becomes inert during paper and approval close-ups; previous/next controls remain in the frame with 44px minimum targets. Static responsive and reduced-motion layouts retain manual chapter selection.

dos: Preserve the accepted hero and trajectory geometry.
Retain reduced-motion and shader failure fallbacks.
Keep the retained light web dashboard separately scoped.
donts: Do not represent sample counts or completion states as real submissions.
Do not infer connected desktop Gmail or companion execution from preview UI.
Do not restore superseded green/blue panel tints or broad lime companion/closing bands.
